source: Jeong, Choi, Yoo, RFIC 2009, Fig.4 and Fig.5
implementation_kind: engineering adaptation; not a literal transistor reproduction
frequency_decision_uses: native edge counts only, no timestamps
calibration_feedback: physical PLL fb32, no additional divide by four

calibration_state.final_candidate: keep the fifth tested code; do not apply an untested sixth code
calibration_state.extreme_failure: code1 still fast or code31 still slow => endpoint/range unverified, no handover

bracket.leading_credit: represents immediately preceding half-cycle reference edge
bracket.equal_frequency_invariant: count_lag <= count_div <= count_lead at every ideal event, with simultaneous edges updated atomically
bracket.port_name_convention: fast/slow names describe VCO versus target; Fig4 paper Fast label describes RefClk versus DivClk and thus has opposite verbal polarity
bracket.boundary_ties: ideal model batches ties; physical guard plus epoch/reset sequencing requires MOS validation

physical_count_frontend.cdc: all three words pass matched two-register REF-clock pipelines, then binary decode
physical_count_frontend.qualification: same direction at two consecutive REF observations
physical_count_frontend.count_width_scope: tested VCO/32 <=113MHz and <=192REF measurement cycles keep 8-bit count below wrap; arbitrary input clock faults are not covered
physical_count_frontend.phase_select_reset: hold reference counters in reset until phase selector and seen buffers settle; startup ghost edges must not count
physical_count_frontend.physical_controller_clock_gating: REF & !(fine_enable|fail), intended self-gating after handover; runt-pulse/tail stability needs MOS verification; phase-generator input gates can still toggle
physical_count_frontend.MOS_window_priority_difference_from_RTL_: MOS cg7 deadline can select provisional near before a first raw sign gets its second qualification; RTL spec waits for raw sign to qualify or disappear

sequencing.physical_MEASURE_watchdog: native8bit measure timer mt7 & mt6, reaches192REFcycles
sequencing.RTL_counter_fault_input: richer abstract external fault contract; physical MOS lacks general overflow/sync-invalid detector

near_timeout.meaning: provisional tested candidate, not a measured exact frequency or proven all-PVT capture guarantee
near_timeout.required_validation: actual physical fine-loop capture and control-voltage rail margin after handover
near_timeout.output: candidate_provisional=1, done=1, fine_enable after two REF cycles
